mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0% (based on historical data from 2000-2022).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 5.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive Fed tightening that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy > 5.0% (based on historical data from 2000-2022).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% and acceleration in non-farm payrolls above 145,000 thousand signals robust labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5 and PAYEMS > 145000 (based on historical data from 2000-2022).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1,200 thousand units indicate weakening consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during housing market downturns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1200 (based on historical data from 2000-2022).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 104.0 (2017=100) signals economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 104.0 (based on historical data from 2000-2022).

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption expenditures above 470,000 million dollars indicate strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 470000 (based on historical data from 2000-2022).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 105.0 combined with rising federal funds rate above 1.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening suppressing economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0 and FEDFUNDS > 1.0 (based on historical data from 2000-2022).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate rising above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5 (based on historical data from 2000-2022).
